· Current Price($2,203.77) vs SMA5($2,311.27)/SMA20($2,403.58)/SMA50($2,528.78): Diagnosing short-to-medium term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100($2,333.3)/SMA200($2,158.89): Potential shift to a weaker long-term trend.
· 52-week position (28.6%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (35.9 → 28.3): Entering oversold territory, suggesting potential for a bounce.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-10.0711 → -13.0239): Continued worsening, maintaining a bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (near lower band $2,257.44): Approaching the lower band, expecting support.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($2,159.28): Based on SMA200, a key defense line.
· Swing Resistance ($2,384.47): Near 5-day high ($2,388.03), acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Higher Low unconfirmed, potential for a Lower High.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.40x 5-day average): Increased volume during sharp decline, indicating potential for a rebound.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Bounce expected due to RSI entering oversold and increased volume, but lack of conviction for trend reversal due to worsening MACD and weak ADX trend, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
